newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Dec 16.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Dec 16.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

-------- COMMENTS - Singapore bunkers rose on good demand ahead of the Christmas holidays and tight supplies, traders said on Monday. Some of the cargoes have been absorbed by China, dampening bunker supplies, they said. The pre-Christmas demand is expected to keep prices supported for most of this week, traders said. A major said he sold 500 tonnes of 180-cst supplies at $124 per tonne. -- Singapore newsroom (65-0870-3082)
